summary: The Zcash ETF, a Delaware trust sponsored by Grayscale Investments Sponsors, LLC, filed a Form 8-K on September 18, 2026, announcing a 3-for-1 forward share split. Shareholders of record on September 28, 2026, will receive two additional shares payable after market close on September 29, 2026, with split-adjusted trading beginning September 30, 2026, on NYSE Arca under ticker ZCSH. No board recommendation or advisor is stated. The split reduces NAV per share to one-third but does not alter total investment value. No deal terms exist, so the risk-arb angle is limited to mechanical trading adjustments.
